subject: general
question: Which programme was launched to trace missing and abandoned children and reunite them with their families?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Smile**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Smile** is a programme launched to trace missing and abandoned children and reunite them with their families.
 
• The programme involves coordinated efforts by police departments across various states in India.
 
• It aims to identify, track, and recover missing children, ensuring their safety and well-being.
 
• Operation Smile is part of a broader initiative to protect vulnerable children and address issues of child trafficking and exploitation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other operations with similar goals include **Operation Muskaan**, which also focuses on rescuing and rehabilitating missing children.
 
• These initiatives often involve collaboration with NGOs, child welfare organizations, and government agencies.
 
• Public awareness campaigns are also a crucial component of these operations to educate communities about child safety and reporting mechanisms.
 
• Both Operation Smile and Operation Muskaan have been successful in reuniting thousands of children with their families.
